title: Classic American Cornbread Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting dish that combines the flavors of cornbread and casserole for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
Drain excess fat from the skillet and set the cooked beef aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cornbread mix, sour cream, eggs, and shredded cheese.
Stir in the canned creamed corn and diced tomatoes.
Add the cooked ground beef to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
